title: Resubmit - Local police data sharing with LexisNexis

communications.subject: Texas Public Information Act Request: Resubmit - Local police data sharing with LexisNexis
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Texas Public Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Your agency was identified as one that is sharing data with LexisNexis via either the Accurint Virtual Crime Center (AVCC) or the Community Crime Map (CCM). LexisNexis sells access to this data via AVCC to 2,400 law enforcement agencies around the U.S. including ICE. We are working on a story and seek to understand what data your department is sharing, and what audits are being conducted relating to the use of this data. 

1) Signed/executed "AVCC XML Addendum" that is typically attached to a Schedule A or other contracting documents. This dictates what data your agency is required to share, and who it is shared with. To aid in the search, a unique keyword within this document is "PSDEX"
2) Deleted/Withdrawn
3) Audit of how your data is used: If available, an audit export of how other agencies are accessing and using your department's data. Timeframe: January 1 , 2026 - November 8, 2026.
4) Audit of your agency's queries: An audit of your agency's queries of the AVCC system, from January 1, 2026 - November 8, 2026

I have narrowed the scope and timeframe from my previous request. Thank you for your help with this.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Shawn Segal
